an5.223:1.3: bahubhaṇḍo hoti bahubhaṇḍasannicayo bahubhesajjo hoti bahubhesajjasannicayo bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo abyatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto sāpekkho pakkamati
an5.223:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā abhinivāse.
an5.223:2.3: na bahubhaṇḍo hoti na bahubhaṇḍasannicayo na bahubhesajjo hoti na bahubhesajjasannicayo na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo byatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu asaṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto anapekkho pakkamati
an5.223:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthanivāseti.
